security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown code spans, TypeScript examples, and Genkit documentation commands. The only confirmed issue is global npm CLI installation guidance, which can modify the developer environment and run package lifecycle code. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious network behavior was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before package installation and prefer a project-local dev dependency or version-pinned npx invocation.

content.value_statement: Genkit changes quickly, and outdated examples cause broken TypeScript flows. This skill guides setup, documentation lookup, examples, and troubleshooting for current Genkit JavaScript work.
actual_capabilities: Guides Genkit CLI version checks and documentation lookup.
Helps set up Genkit in Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Firebase, or Express projects.
Shows current Genkit v1.x import, model, flow, and schema patterns.
Troubleshoots common migration, Zod, streaming, multimodal, and provider errors.
Provides examples for text generation, structured output, streaming, image, and speech workflows.
Encourages type checks and reference-first fixes after changes.
limitations: It depends on the Genkit CLI and local project tooling being available.
It does not manage cloud credentials or provider billing.
It cannot verify model availability without current documentation or provider checks.
It does not replace security review for generated AI tools and flows.

prompt_templates.title: Set up Genkit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup in a TypeScript project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up Genkit in this TypeScript project. Check the existing structure, choose a provider with me, and explain each file you add.

prompt_templates.title: Create a flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Genkit flow for my feature. Use current Genkit v1.x APIs, define clear schemas, and show how I can test it.

prompt_templates.title: Debug an error
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting after a build or type failure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this Genkit error. Compare it with known migration issues first, then propose the smallest fix and verification step.

prompt_templates.title: Plan provider support
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture for multiple model providers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a provider-agnostic Genkit approach for this app. Include plugin choices, model lookup steps, flow boundaries, and operational risks.

output_examples.input: Help me set up Genkit in a new Next.js app.
output_examples.output: A setup plan with provider selection, source directory placement, configuration files, and commands to run after confirmation.

output_examples.input: My Genkit flow fails after upgrading from an older version.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis that checks deprecated imports, response property access, model references, Zod usage, and a type-check verification step.

output_examples.input: Add image generation with Gemini through Genkit.
output_examples.output: Guidance for the image model, response modalities, prompt structure, provider documentation checks, and expected media output handling.

best_practices: Verify current Genkit docs before relying on remembered APIs.
Keep flows, tools, and Genkit configuration in separate source files.
Store provider credentials in environment variables and never hardcode them.
anti_patterns: Using deprecated pre-1.0 imports or response methods.
Running package installation commands without user confirmation.
Building complex schemas before confirming Genkit support and type checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps build, configure, test, and troubleshoot Genkit JavaScript and TypeScript applications.

faq.question: Does it only support Google AI?
faq.answer: No. It defaults to Google AI when no provider is specified, but it can guide other provider plugins.

faq.question: Can it create new Genkit flows?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help define flows, schemas, tools, and examples that match current Genkit APIs.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill references CLI commands. Users should approve package installation and project-changing commands first.

faq.question: How does it handle API changes?
faq.answer: It prioritizes the included migration notes, common errors, and Genkit CLI documentation lookup.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
